def solve(case):
    items = case['items'][:]  # copy
    required = set(case['required_failure_items'])
    chunk_size = 2
    attempts = 0
    while chunk_size <= len(items):
        success = False
        # try all chunks from left to right
        for i in range(len(items) - chunk_size + 1):
            attempts += 1
            candidate = items[:i] + items[i+chunk_size:]
            # check if all required items are in candidate
            if required.issubset(candidate):
                items = candidate
                success = True
                break  # accept first successful removal
        if success:
            chunk_size += 1  # slightly coarser
        else:
            chunk_size *= 2  # double
    # one-minimal check
    one_minimal = True
    for i in range(len(items)):
        candidate = items[:i] + items[i+1:]
        if required.issubset(candidate):
            one_minimal = False
            break
    return {
        "attempts": attempts,
        "one_minimal": one_minimal,
        "reduced_items": items
    }
